name: Kindness
description: Kindness word search puzzles gather calm adult social English — care, help, patience, courtesy, comfort and everyday good-manner words — without brand slogans or self-help catchphrases. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays gentle and familiar: friend, grace, invite, honest, cheer and apology vocabulary many seniors and home solvers already know. This hub pairs well with Friendship and Gratitude when you want a longer soft session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as quiet as a handwritten note. No medical claims — only everyday courtesy English.
